info.title: Agent Task Board API
info.description: Real-time task board for LLM agents and humans. Errors: {code, message, details}.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: Resume after this seq (alternative to the Last-Event-ID header).

get.summary:
`GET /api/stream?topics=questions,reviews`: cross-project inbox stream. No resume: clients
refetch their inbox on reconnect (per-project seqs cannot form one global cursor).

Board.description:
Board snapshot. `seq` is the project event counter at read time: open the SSE stream with
`after=seq` to receive exactly the changes that happen after this snapshot.

task_id.description: Omit to let the server pick the best claimable task.

CommandResult.description: Result of every task command (REST and MCP). Stored verbatim for idempotent replays.

lease_token.description: Returned once, by `claim`. Present it on every later write (fencing).

workflow.description: Workflow config (§5). Defaults: every gate on, LEASE_TTL_SECS / PREFERRED_GRACE_SECS.

token.description: Bearer token for agents and verifiers. Shown ONCE; only its SHA-256 is stored.

ErrorBody.description: Error body of every REST response (§8).

gateway_subject.description: Identity forwarded by the MCP gateway: `client:<oauth client id>` or `email:<address>`.

spec_version.description: Defaults to the approved version, else the latest.

title.description: Required when creating a spec; optional (renames) when proposing a version.

StoredEvent.description: A row of the append-only `events` table, as sent over SSE and `/events`.

only_live.description: Rows present live but not produced by the replay.

only_rebuilt.description: Rows produced by the replay but absent live.

TaskContext.description: Everything an agent needs before acting on a task (`get_task`, §7).

TaskView.description: A task as shown on the board (§10): state, holder with lease, derived badges.

blocked.description: Derived: a `blocks` predecessor is not done.
